request: Build the Abbaas Ledger designed in the canvas at https://claude.ai/artifact/XpzsEF5ovaU7cB3wYp5bEi as a mobile-friendly website for one owner. The owner sends money to people on Abbaas's behalf, in US dollars or in Maldivian rufiyaa at a rate they type, and Abbaas pays the owner back, usually in dollars. The app records each send and each repayment and shows, in USD, whether Abbaas has the owner's money or the owner has Abbaas's money, and how much. The front end is a static site on GitHub Pages; the backend is Supabase on its free tier, set up the same way as the meals project at /Users/Yuki/Claude/meals. The code lives in a new repository at /Users/Yuki/Claude/abbaas-ledger.

values.observation: On the first visit on a phone the owner signs in once with email and password; every later visit, including opening the app from the home-screen icon, goes straight to Home with no sign-in screen; the ledger belongs to that account, and a second account sees none of its entries or people.

With no entries, Home shows both boxes as empty dashed outlines with $0 (You on the left, Abbaas on the right), an All square chip, a hint to use Send or Receive, a Send button at the bottom left and a Receive button at the bottom right.

values.observation: Tapping Send opens the blue form; the owner enters an amount in USD, picks a paid-to person from the saved list or adds a new one, keeps or changes the date, optionally adds a note, and sees the after-saving boxes; saving returns to Home where the entry sits right of the centre line and Abbaas's box is filled with the new balance, shown without a sign, with the caption has your money.

values.observation: In the send form, switching to MVR shows a rate field (MVR per $1) and the dollar value worked out as the owner types, for example MVR 10,000 at 20.00 shows $500.00; saving stores the MVR amount, the rate and that USD value, and the entry reads MVR 10,000 at 20.00 under its $500.00.

values.observation: Tapping Receive opens the teal form; the owner enters what Abbaas paid (USD, or MVR with a rate), or taps All of it, $500 or $1,000, and sees the after-saving boxes; saving puts the entry left of the centre line and lowers what Abbaas holds. A payment larger than he holds shows a note before saving and, once saved, empties his box and fills the owner's blue box with the difference and the caption have his money; a payment equal to what he holds leaves both boxes empty and shows All square.
